vulnerability.name: GO-2026-5932
vulnerability.description: The golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package is unmaintained, unsafe by design, and has known security issues

statements.impact_statement: govulncheck (v1.9.0, run 2026-11-14 on main at 0.6.0) found that the vulnerable code (the package golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp) is not called by any package of blobgate; the module is required by rclone and is not used for OpenPGP.
